manifest.description: Use this skill when the user wants to read or search their Monologue notes through the Monologue Notes REST API. It covers authentication with the MONOLOGUE_API_KEY environment variable, safe token handling, listing notes, fetching a single note, pagination, filters, and error handling. The API is read-only and should be accessed with direct HTTP requests such as curl or any equivalent REST client.
